historical_references.reference: Azmira was an ancient Hindu goddess of beauty and love. She was identified with the goddess Apsara Riddhi, who was the embodiment of riches and prosperity. Azmira is mentioned in various ancient Indian texts, including the Mahabharata and the Puranas.

Another reference to Azmira can be found in the Jain scriptures, where she is described as the goddess of love and desire. She is said to have tempted the Jain ascetics with her beauty and charms, but ultimately failed to distract them from their spiritual pursuits.
